# Eighth review of SEEN-108, attempt 11, from the seen-reviewer subagent

Spawned fresh on opus with the task text of triage record 118, asked to judge
whether the guard sweep was scope creep, and told note 110's rule did not ask it
to soften anything. Verdict `return`, five findings, three blocking.

It judged the widening from 36 files to 48 justified and not scope creep: a
repository-wide invariant that exempts the modules violating it is decoration,
and the per-file diff is a line or two. It judged `slice_files` a plan-accuracy
gap for the seventh time. And it confirmed advance 117's failure reason verbatim
against check 112, the first in this journal it could say was not written from
what the session had been reading.

- **F1, blocking, harness/tests/test_kpi.py.** `OutcomeReconcilesTest` asserts
  the outcome is exactly one ahead of the journal, which is true when the
  section is written and false the moment the advance it anticipates is
  recorded. At HEAD the journal holds eleven tdd advances and the outcome says
  eleven, so `11 != 12`; correcting the number does not help, because the next
  advance makes it thirteen. The guard written against stale counts is a ratchet
  that guarantees them.
- **F2, blocking, the ticket file.** The outcome says six reviews and
  thirty-one findings where the journal now holds seven notes and thirty-six.
  Notes 116 and 117 were appended after regression 114, so the fingerprint check
  in triage 118 still passed while the suite it attests had gone red: the
  journal is outside the fingerprint by design, and this test reads the journal.
- **F3, blocking, harness/agents.py.** The committed copies carry slice 4's
  route. After the receipt this ticket is no longer unfinished, so
  `ticket_in_hand` returns nothing, `routed` falls back to the strongest at high
  effort, and `doctor` reports drift on the exact commit being merged;
  `verify-merge` then refuses on red CI. The copies cannot be re-synced, because
  `.claude/agents/` is not in `delivery.DELIVERY_WRITES`, so a fix commit after
  the receipt makes `verify-merge` refuse for a tree that changed. After a merge
  every push to main is red for the same reason. This ticket as built cannot
  merge. The ticket's own `DetachedHeadTest` asserts the fallback at exactly
  that state and never asserts doctor is clean there, so the suite blesses it.
- **F4, medium, harness/agents.py.** The pack and the copies disagree about
  which slice is in hand whenever a boundary is recorded without `--slice-done`:
  the pack infers from greens, `routed` reads the declaration and skips an
  undeclared handoff. The next session reads the pack, spawns from the file, and
  works the slice on the other model. Record 17 already shows the two numbers
  diverging, declared three and inferred four.
- **F5, low, four test modules.** The import sweep put `import unittest` above
  the module docstring in test_routing, test_enforcement, test_repository and
  test_status_check, so each carries no `__doc__` and the fourteen lines
  explaining that no test there calls the Jev API document nothing.
